name: CursorCraft – Cursor Builder for Elementor
author: webbhavan

sections.description:
CursorCraft – Cursor Builder for Elementor is a powerful, lightweight addon that lets you turn any Elementor Container into a fully functioning custom mouse cursor. Instead of being limited to basic shapes, you can use Elementor’s native drag-and-drop builder to design your cursor exactly how you want it!

🌟 Free Features

  • Container as Cursor: Use Elementor Containers to design anything from simple dots to complex animated widgets, and set them to follow the mouse.
  • Global Cursors: Instantly apply your custom cursor across your entire WordPress website.
  • Smooth Physics: Choose between instant tracking or smooth, spring-like physics with a customizable speed slider.
  • Interactive Scaling: Automatically scale the cursor up or down when the user hovers over clickable elements (links, buttons, inputs).
  • Custom Text Highlight: Automatically override the browser’s default blue text selection color to perfectly match your custom cursor!
  • Click Shrink Feedback: Add subtle tactile feedback that smoothly shrinks the cursor when you press down on elements.
  • 1-Click Duplicate: Easily duplicate your entire custom cursor and all of its settings with a single click.
  • Fully Responsive: Easily hide the custom cursor on tablets and mobile devices to save performance and battery life.

🚀 Pro Features (Unlock Your True Potential)

Take your designs to the absolute limit with CursorCraft Pro.
Upgrade to CursorCraft Pro Here!

  • Magnetic Snapping: Automatically pull and snap your cursor to the exact center of buttons and icons for a premium, app-like feel.
  • Spotlight (Flashlight) Mode: Cast a gorgeous, dark blurred overlay across the entire website that only reveals the content perfectly underneath the mouse.
  • Scroll Progress Ring: Wrap an elegant, customizable SVG ring around your cursor that perfectly tracks reading progress as users scroll down the page.
  • Advanced Blend Modes: Apply CSS mix-blend-modes (like Difference or Exclusion) so your cursor dynamically reacts to and inverts the background colors behind it.
  • Dynamic Hover Text: Inject dynamic text into your cursor (e.g., “VIEW”, “PLAY”, “BUY”) based on what the user is hovering over.
  • 5 Premium Particle Trails: Add jaw-dropping particle effects behind your cursor, including Neon Ghosting, Smooth Canvas Comets, Sprinkling Stars, Floating Bubbles, and Image Sequences.
  • Premium Animations: Access advanced entrance and exit animations for seamless hover transitions.
  • Advanced Display Rules: Build complex logic to only show cursors on WooCommerce products, Custom Post Types, or specific archives.
  • Multiple Display Conditions: Stack and combine multiple display rules on a single cursor for precise, granular control.
  • Pro Starter Templates: Instantly import complex WebGL-style effects like Liquid Distortion, Neon Pulse, Ghost Trails, and Particle Effects.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the ZIP file via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to CursorCraft in your WordPress dashboard menu.
  4. Click Add New Cursor to create a new cursor template.
  5. Set your Display Conditions (e.g. Entire Site or Specific Selector) in the box below the title.
  6. Click Edit with Elementor to visually design your cursor.
  7. Inside the Elementor editor, select your main Container, navigate to the Advanced Tab, and enable the Custom Cursor section to configure your physics and animations.
sections.faq:
Does this slow down my website?

No! The plugin is extremely lightweight and uses GPU-accelerated CSS transforms (translate and scale) alongside requestAnimationFrame for buttery smooth, zero-lag performance.

How do I hide it on mobile?

In the Elementor Advanced Tab under the Custom Cursor section, make sure “Hide on Tablet” and “Hide on Mobile” are enabled. The plugin will intelligently disable the cursor logic on smaller screens to restore the default mouse pointer.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Major Feature (Pro): Added 5 Premium Cursor Trail Effects! Choose between Neon Ghosting (DOM), Smooth Comet (Canvas), Sprinkling Stars (Canvas), Floating Bubbles (Canvas), or Image Sequences (DOM).
  • Major Feature: Added full native support for Elementor Lottie Animations inside custom cursors. Lottie animations will now flawlessly auto-play and loop inside your custom cursor pointer!
  • Feature (Pro): Added 4 brand-new Pro Starter Templates specifically designed to showcase the new Premium Cursor Trails.
  • Enhancement: Rebuilt the Elementor Editor UI using native “Tabs”. Free and Pro settings are now elegantly split into separate “Core” and “Pro FX” tabs, eliminating endless scrolling and drastically cleaning up the workspace.
  • Enhancement: Replaced the legacy “Hide on Tablet” and “Hide on Mobile” toggles with a single, highly flexible “Disable Below Screen Size (px)” slider. (Fully backward compatible with older setups).
  • Enhancement: Rewrote the touch event listeners using passive events to ensure buttery smooth performance on mobile devices.

1.0.9

  • Feature: Added a new “Custom Text Highlight Color” option so your website’s text selection perfectly matches your cursor design.
  • Feature: Added a “Click Shrink Feedback” toggle that gives your users an incredibly satisfying, tactile shrink effect when they click links.
  • Enhancement: Added a helpful Pro Tip in the Elementor editor recommending the Navigator for selecting tiny cursors.

1.0.8

  • Fix: Removed custom cursor from incorrectly rendering inside the Elementor Editor Preview frame.
  • Enhancement: Updated UI screenshot references and removed the legacy 1-Click Setup Wizard block.

1.0.7

  • Feature: Added a beautiful “Pro Features” preview overlay inside the Elementor Advanced Tab.
  • Enhancement: Major architectural upgrade to the Display Rules engine to support stacked conditions (backward compatible).
  • Fix: Handled an edge case where deactivating the Pro version would leave the display rule dropdown blank. It now correctly shows a fallback.

1.0.6

  • Fixed: Completely removed custom cursor Javascript and CSS from loading within the Elementor Editor, restoring the default mouse pointer and preventing all editor conflicts.

1.0.5

  • Fixed: Resolved a critical issue where the Elementor Editor would continuously load or crash due to DOM manipulation conflicts.

1.0.4

  • Enhancement: Updated Starter Templates dashboard to actively highlight the official launch of CursorCraft Pro.
  • Enhancement: Converted disabled templates into direct “Upgrade to Pro” links to maximize conversions.

1.0.3

  • Fix: Prevented Elementor Advanced Tab ordering bug on older websites using legacy Sections instead of Flexbox Containers.
  • Fix: Removed aggressive clipping mask to allow custom cursors to natively expand beyond their borders without being cut off.
  • Enhancement: Made the “Specific Target / CSS Selector” description text dynamically switch based on user selection to prevent confusion.

1.0.2

  • Feature: Added a dedicated “How to Use” onboarding page to the WordPress dashboard.
  • Fix: Aligned “Display Rules” conditional logic labels between the Free and Pro versions.

1.0.1

  • Major architectural upgrade: Cursors are now managed as Custom Post Types in a centralized dashboard.
  • Added “Starter Templates” support.
  • Added Native Accessibility Support (Respects OS Reduced Motion).
  • Added “Exclude Selectors” to dynamically hide the custom cursor on specific elements.
  • Rebuilt the condition engine for better performance and scalability.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
